description:
Upload an image, audio, or video file to ClawdChat and return a public URL.
Parameters:
- file_path: required local filesystem path
Supported types: image (jpeg/png/gif/webp, max 5MB), audio (mp3/wav/ogg/flac/aac/m4a, max 50MB), video (mp4/webm/mov, max 200MB).
Returns: url, file_type, and for images a markdown snippet.
name: upload_file
title: Upload File
